crossRefs.note: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?
crossRefs.keyword: evident unto you. Heb. before your face. if I lie

crossRefs.note: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.
crossRefs.keyword: evident unto you. Heb. before your face. if I lie

translations.web: Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.
translations.bsb: But now, please look at me. Would I lie to your face?
translations.kjv: Now therefore be content, look upon me; for it is evident unto you if I lie.
translations.asv: Now therefore be pleased to look upon me; For surely I shall not lie to your face.
